pick.name: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo
pick.what: Workspace package manager + cached task runner
pick.why: Lightest setup that Expo officially supports; Turborepo needs one turbo.json; Vercel Remote Cache now free
pick.free_limits: Remote cache free (Vercel changelog linked from fair-use page)
pick.install: npm i -g pnpm && pnpm dlx create-turbo@latest

alts.name: Nx
alts.what: Monorepo build system with generators/plugins (Expo, Next, Electron)
alts.why: Better when the repo grows to many apps/teams; affected-graph CI
alts.free_limits: Nx Cloud free tier not verified

alts.name: Bun workspaces (+Turborepo)
alts.why: Fastest installs; Expo supports Bun workspaces

candidates.name: pnpm + Turborepo (pick)
candidates.verdict: Most common combo in 2026 TS monorepos; 27.6M weekly turbo downloads.

candidates.name: Nx
candidates.verdict: Wins at larger scale or when you want code generators; heavier config Claude must maintain.

candidates.name: Bun workspaces
candidates.verdict: Fast; some native RN/Electron tooling still assumes Node - keep Node as runtime.

candidates.name: Lerna 10
candidates.verdict: Now Nx-backed; no reason to choose over Nx/Turbo.

decision: pnpm + Turborepo is the least config for a small team and is what the Better-T-Stack scaffold generates. Switch to Nx if you exceed ~10 apps/packages or need enforced module boundaries.
details: Expo + pnpm: SDK 54+ supports isolated installs, but if a native module fails set nodeLinker: hoisted in pnpm-workspace.yaml (Expo docs). Never let two React Native or React versions coexist.
